notes.title: Updated to Ver. 1.1
notes.content:
・The dialogue at launch has been abolished, and you can now set the resolution, screen mode, and key configuration from the pause screen in the game.
・You can now also set the BGM volume and SE volume, which was not possible in previous versions.
・Fixed an issue where the buttons used on the Xbox controller were different from what was expected.
・Adjusted the BGM and SE volumes.
・The maximize window button can no longer be pressed because it is possible to set the resolution to an unexpected one (full screen is possible from the pause screen).
・Fixed an issue where the defense would not be released and the game would not progress if you defeated a dragon by simultaneously inputting defense and attack.
・Fixed an issue where the game would not progress if you pressed stage confirmation while dashing and left the stone statue.



Please be careful with the Mac version.
To play Ver1.0 save data in Ver1.1, please follow the steps below.
(Windows users can play Ver1.1 as is)

1. Exit the game

2. Open MachntoshHD/username/Library/Preferences

3. Rename "unity.Ichthyostego.SHE SAVE.plist" to "com.Ichthyostego.SHE-SAVE.plist"
"unity." will change to "com."
"Space" will change to "-"

4. Run "killall -u $USER cfprefsd" in the terminal

*If you have played Ver1.1 before the above steps, com.Ichthyostego.SHE-SAVE.plist may already have been generated in the terminal.
In that case, delete com.Ichthyostego.SHE-SAVE.plist and then proceed with the above steps.
